title: /clear reports 'Conversation cleared.' but clears nothing
observed: After /clear the screen keeps every earlier turn, and the next request to the model still carries the whole prior conversation (PTY test TestTUI_ClearStartsFresh: the request after /clear contains 'remember the word pelican'). internal/cli/commands.go wires OnClear to a no-op func(){}.
expected: Design copy for /clear: 'Start a fresh session'. After /clear the model sees no earlier turns and the transcript starts empty under the banner, with the 'Conversation cleared.' note.
